In the given equation, 14 represents the height of the tree at the given time, and 6 represents the height of the tree when it was planted. It follows that \x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"2 n\">\x3C/span>&nbsp;represents the number of feet the tree grew from the time it was planted until the time it reached a height of 14 feet. Since \x3Cspan>n\x3C/span> represents the number of years between the given time and the time the tree was planted, 2 must represent the average number of feet the tree grew each year.\x3C/p>\x3Cp>Choice A is incorrect and may result from interpreting the coefficient 2 as doubling instead of as increasing by 2 each year.
